name: Hunan Xiangtou Goldsky Titanium Industry Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Xiangtou Goldsky Titanium Industry Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of titanium and titanium alloy materials and welded pipes in China. The company offers titanium and titanium alloy bars, forging billets and blanks, and parts. Its products are used in aerospace, aerospace, shipbuilding, weaponry, and other fields. Hunan Xiangtou Goldsky Titanium Industry Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Changde, China.
